name: Mariners Adventure Camp
description_short: A week-long day camp at the Maine Maritime Museum in Bath for students entering grades 6 to 8. Campers learn traditional ship trades such as carpentry, blacksmithing, sailmaking and navigation, and take a trip to Bailey Island to sail a schooner.

sessions.name: Session 1: Leading from the Helm (open to campers of underrepresented identities)
Session 2: Makers and Mariners (listed as sold out)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Grades are rising grades 6 to 8; ages 11 to 14 derived from grades. Address is the museum's address on the page.
